The soleplate is dark, possibly cast iron or coated metal, with visible steam holes and some residue or wear. A pink fabric (possibly a towel or garment) is draped in the foreground. To the left, a white vertical object (likely part of an ironing board leg or another appliance) is visible. The lighting is dim, creating reflections on the glossy tiles.
